scope: Selected source packet, final answer, and persisted ledger review; not an expert or investment-outcome rating

common.criterion: Material figures, period labels, units, source identifiers, and GAAP/non-GAAP basis agree with the selected packet; no omitted filing content is presented as reviewed.
Every stated difference, ratio, direction, and comparison basis can be independently recomputed from the selected packet to its stated precision.
A causal or quantitative attribution is directly supported or explicitly bounded as a hypothesis; line-item compatibility alone is not called a complete bridge.
Final answer accurately describes the actual stored thesis decision, evidence, hold/actionability, review link, and alert state; claimed tool actions are present in the trace.

The answer offers a case-specific research implication, strongest material counterpoint or unresolved input, and discriminating evidence that would change the view; generic recitation or generic abstention is insufficient for high quality.

AFRM-FISCAL-COST.criterion: FY2024 Q4 to FY2025 Q1 is an adjacent fiscal-quarter comparison, not matching-quarter year-over-year growth.
Revenue rises 39,294 USD thousand while non-GAAP RLTC falls 24,271 and transaction costs rise 63,565; RLTC is not GAAP profit.
Higher provision and funding costs are identified, but realized credit-quality deterioration or a complete driver decomposition is not asserted without the missing bridge.

SOFI-REVENUE-BRIDGE.criterion: Q3 GAAP total net revenue 697,121 and non-GAAP adjusted net revenue 689,445 USD thousand are kept distinct.
The Q3 bridge is 697,121 - 4,362 + 9 - 3,323 = 689,445 USD thousand; adjustment signs are preserved.
GAAP net income rises 43,341 USD thousand sequentially, but no single-segment cause is asserted from consolidated values alone.

UPST-MIXED-BASIS.criterion: Q3 2024 GAAP operating loss improves versus Q2 2024 but worsens versus Q3 2023; Q3 adjusted net loss likewise improves sequentially but worsens year over year.
The 33,361 USD thousand debt-extinguishment gain below operating income is recognized; narrowing GAAP net loss is not wholly called operating improvement.
Q3 GAAP net income remains negative; contribution profit and adjusted EBITDA are non-GAAP and are not presented as GAAP earnings.
